content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: (i) B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized university or equivalent, and 03 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services; OR (ii) M.E./M.Tech./Integrated Masters in Civil Engineering or Technology with specialization in Highway Engineering or any equivalent specialization from a recognized university, and 02 years' experience in the same fields. Experience required: 03 years' experience in Research and Development (with the B.E./B.Tech route) or 02 years' (with the M.E./M.Tech. route), in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Pay: Rs. 42,000 +HRA. Qualification required: Masters degree in Commerce from a recognized University and Post Graduate Diploma in Intellectual Property Rights from a recognized University / Institution. Desirable: Commercial and Accounting competence; Working Knowledge of IP law and filing procedure. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Rs. 25,000 + HRA.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Monthly emoluments are printed as Rs. 42,000/-+HRA and Rs. 25,000/-+ HRA; the HRA amount is not printed. Senior Project Associate: 08 months (may be extended up to 30 September 2028 subject to availability of funds) or co-terminus with project, whichever is earlier. Engagement is purely on temporary basis. Total period of engagement under one project and/or a combination of projects in CSIR laboratories shall not exceed 06 years cumulatively. Selected candidates cannot discontinue without prior approval of the Director; they must give one month's prior notice with the specific reason or deposit one month's stipend in lieu of notice.

content_sections.heading: How Will CSIR-CRRI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview If a large number of candidates turn up, shortlisting for interview as per criteria fixed by the Selection Committee In case a large number of candidates turn up, candidates will be shortlisted for interview as per criteria fixed by the Selection Committee. The final decision to allow a candidate to appear for interview rests with the Director, CSIR-CRRI.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Annexure-I application form, filled in Original and self-attested copies of all certificates/testimonials Valid identity proof (Voter ID card/PAN Card/Driving License/Passport/Aadhar Card) One passport size photograph NOC in Annexure-II format, if higher degree is ongoing under AcSIR or an MoU university SC/ST/PwBD/OBC candidates: original certificate in proper format from the Appropriate Authority Passport copy if resided abroad in the last 5 years; proof of CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR/NET/GATE qualification if qualified

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CSIR-CRRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 18 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-CRRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Senior Project Associate, 1 Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSIR-CRRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 18 November 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: CSIR-CRRI, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Senior Project Associate: maximum 40 years; Project Associate-I: maximum 35 years. Relaxation: SC/ST/PwBD/Women 5 years, OBC 3 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 42,000 +HRA for Senior Project Associate, Rs. 25,000 + HRA for Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Senior Project Associate: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering with 3 years' R&D experience, OR M.E./M.Tech./Integrated Masters in Civil Engineering or Technology (Highway Engineering or equivalent specialization) with 2 years' experience. Project Associate-I: Masters degree in Commerce from a recognized University and Post Graduate Diploma in Intellectual Property Rights from a recognized University / Institution. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates are encouraged to speak in Hindi during the walk-in interview. Age, educational qualification and experience are treated on the date of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No candidate will be allowed to appear in the interview without the original certificates.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. If a large number of candidates turn up, shortlisting for interview as per criteria fixed by the Selection Committee. In case a large number of candidates turn up, candidates will be shortlisted for interview as per criteria fixed by the Selection Committee. The final decision to allow a candidate to appear for interview rests with the Director, CSIR-CRRI.
